text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: GPU memory pressure detected on pool eu-west-1-gpu-pool-42 (50% of GPUs > 92% memory). Auto-shedding engaged.

pagerduty: Incident #PD-8421 — triggered by gpu-memory-threshold-eu-west1. Impact: elevated inference errors and request latency for some customers.

alex: acked. oncall taking a look.

priya: jumping in — seeing a spike in CUDA OOM logs on node g-node-42-07, kernel=CUDA_ERROR_UNKNOWN then retries. Logs: ```2026-03-17T02:08:12Z ERROR cuda: alloc failed: out of memory (requested 124MB) stack...```

jamie: customers affected include acme-marketing (low-volume spikes) and beta-corp (observed 5xxs on /v1/stream). Not widespread but multi-tenant.

laura: timeline: started ~02:02 UTC. Auto-evict ran twice, then auto-shedder limited batch size which reduced throughput but not errors.

priya: attempting quick mitigation: lowering batch_size for pool eu-west-1 -> 1 (runtime config) and enabling kv-cache eviction aggressive mode. Pushing now.

alex: please also reroute traffic for acme-marketing to eu-west-2 secondary pool via routing policy 'region-fallback' if available. Can someone flip the route?

sre-shift: on it — issuing route change: `redwood route update --customer acme-marketing --to eu-west-2-gpu-pool-11 --reason "mem pressure eu-west-1"`

pagerduty: note — reroute will add ~30-50ms latency for that customer. No rate limits changes.

jamie: reducing model variant for beta-corp to quantized-8bit variant to reduce memory per-infer. Sending rollout now.

priya: node g-node-42-07 has repeated cgroup kill traces, I'm cordoning it for immediate drain: `kubectl cordon g-node-42-07 && kubectl drain g-node-42-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

laura: good. Starting drain. Evicted 18 pods, scheduler rescheduled to other nodes but remaining pool is tight.

alex: request to infra to spin up 2x spare GPUs in eu-west-1 as emergency capacity. Priya can you open the capacity request?

priya: opened capacity request CH-3789 to cloud-provider with priority P0. ETA ~8-12 minutes for new instances.

jamie: monitoring: error rate for /v1/infer for beta-corp down from 4.5% -> 1.2% after variant switch. ACME still seeing occasional 502s during reroute.

incident-bot: Update: auto-shedder suppressed large batches at 02:12 UTC; fallback variant enabled for 3 customers.

pagerduty: Escalation: if error rate >2% sustained for next 10m, escalate to SRE lead. Current 1m avg = 1.8% (sliding).

laura: spare capacity requested, cordon in progress, reroute partly successful. I'm drafting initial customer message for status page.

alex: good first message: "We are investigating GPU memory pressure in eu-west-1 affecting inference for a subset of customers. Mitigations in progress: rerouting traffic, reducing batch sizes, draining affected hosts. No widespread data loss. Updates every 15m." Post and link it here when up.

laura: posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-8421 (public update 02:18 UTC).

priya: cloud provider reports 2 new GPU nodes booting (CH-3789) expected ready ~02:25 UTC.

jamie: after draining the cordoned node, observed freed memory but also fragmentation. Increasing kv-cache eviction frequency seems to help reclaim ~80MB per process.

alex: temporary band-aid: enable model-variant fallback globally for eu-west-1 for non-enterprise customers to avoid new 5xx bursts. Jamie, flip the flag?

jamie: enabling flag now: `redwood feature-toggle set eu-west-1 fallback-variant non-enterprise true` — done.

pagerduty: Reminder to update PD incident status and mark handoff if needed.

priya: new nodes are healthy and joined cluster at 02:27 UTC. Autoscaler placed pending pods; overall pool memory pressure dropping to 68%.

laura: acme-marketing error rate back to baseline after reroute + variant fallback. Beta-corp showing <0.5% errors.

alex: great. next steps: keep node cordoned until fragmentation mitigations (driver update + reboot) complete. Schedule deeper postmortem if we see recurrence.

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> partial (service restored for impacted customers). No active page pending.

pagerduty: PD-8421 resolved at 02:34 UTC (auto-close after stabilization).

priya: handing back to routine oncall, leaving notes in incident ticket CH-3789 with actions taken and suggested follow-ups: kernel-driver upgrade, reduce default batch_size in eu-west-1, add 10% spare GPU capacity buffer.

alex: thanks team. Follow-up owners: infra for capacity buffer (laura), runtime for default batch_size (jamie), driver/ops for kernel patch (priya). I'll schedule a 30min postmortem sync later today.

laura: noted. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
